cues: On sunny weekends, families pedal along the riverside path, stopping at parks for picnics.
A student arrives on campus, locks the frame beside a rack, and heads into class.
At the neighborhood market, shoppers load bread and vegetables into a basket before riding home.
A worker pedals along quiet side streets during the morning commute, avoiding crowded intersections.
Children take turns riding around the driveway while a parent watches from the porch.
After work, friends coast down a gentle hill toward the café, chatting as they travel.
